title: Standby LP recovery — Cure Mermaid + Spirit of the Breeze

cards.name: Cure Mermaid
cards.officialText: As long as this card remains face-up on your side of the field, increase your Life Points by 800 points during each of your Standby Phases.

cards.name: Spirit of the Breeze
cards.officialText: As long as this card remains in face-up Attack Position on your side of the field, increase your Life Points by 1000 points during each of your Standby Phases.

testCoverage: Cure Mermaid gains 800 LP while face-up in either battle position
Spirit of the Breeze gains 1000 LP only in face-up Attack Position
Both effects stack into the shared LP pool of the controller team
Opposing team's monsters do not affect the active team's LP
Face-down monsters do not apply either continuous effect
Effects are suppressed when monster effects are negated
Each team-turn Standby is applied at most once
The next Standby of the same team may apply again
Only the active team may apply its Standby recovery
Existing optional Standby tasks must drain first
UIDs, physical ownership, hands, decks, monster/backrow zones and inventory are conserved
integrationBoundary: Call after advanceStandby returns false for the active team and before the Main Phase actions are exposed. The adapter is isolated and does not modify standbyFlow or the central resolver.
limitations: The adapter is not connected to the central duel resolver, command handlers, persistence or release allowlist.
Tests use Hane-Hane and Man-Eater Bug as already-playable fixture aliases for the two unadmitted card IDs; fixtures do not add cards or certify them.
The host must invoke the adapter once after the existing Standby task queue drains; no live Discord gateway or guild was exercised.
